description: One Apprised.news desk brief (what /api/get-brief serves): the lead, the analyst personas' takes, synthesis, watch items and cited sources, trimmed to a bounded size, with the URL of the full brief. Desks: defense (Defense), culture (Culture), tech (Tech/Cyber), sports (Sports), energy (Energy), insurance (Insurance), health (Health), markets (Markets), intel (Intelligence), world (World), pressure (Politics). The analysts are fictional AI personas; this is AI-generated analysis, not news reporting and not investment advice.

cadence.description: daily (the default), or a retrospective: weekly (dated Mondays), monthly (the 1st), quarterly (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct 1), yearly (Jan 1).

date.description: "latest" (the default) or one UTC date as YYYY-MM-DD.
